why: This holds the violations of ADR-0009 the pages have that nobody has decided
It began holding the ones M1b shipped with: four actions spanning 100% of their
surface and two forms clipping their own content. The forms were fixed in
theme.ts; the four actions closed when the pages were rebuilt on the soft-key
rail, which is what the entries said they were waiting for.
It can only shrink. A finding that is not here fails the build, and an entry
here that no longer matches anything also fails, with 'this is fixed, delete
the line'. Both halves have now been exercised. Anything added must be a
defect with a reason and a way out, never a decision.
The staleness half asks which pages a run actually captured, so an entry on a
state capture — `camera-live-pair` below — is held to it by the run that takes
that capture and ignored by every other. Each entry names the known issue that

accepted.note: K-63. `ui-yonder-aim` is four Dashboard rows — 228 px — and the panel needs 480 px once a gimbal answers `present`: the reason, the slew pad, the commanded rate, two position gauges, the mode line, the mode control and Recentre. The height was chosen against the only state anything could produce, because nothing on any board this repository has run on has ever answered a gimbal. The way out is one of the two K-63 sets out — `height: 0`, which is Dashboard's grow-to-content and the idiom `ui-yonder-deck` already uses, or a panel that fits four rows — and it is the operator's, because the first moves what four already-approved captures look like. Delete this entry when it is taken.

K-63, on the Cockpit's own copy of the same panel (`aim-cockpit`, R-UI-28). One defect, two surfaces, because the two are two call sites of one component and both nodes carry the same height. Whichever way K-63 is closed closes both; delete both entries together.
